[[The Best FIFA Football Awards 2016|2016 (FIFA)]] }} The '''2015 [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]]''' ({{lit|'''2015 FIFA Golden Ball'''}}), was the sixth year for [[FIFA]]'s awards for the top football players and coaches of the year. The awards were given out in Zürich, Switzerland on 11 January 2016. [[Lionel Messi]] won the award as the World Player of the Year for the fifth time, extending his own record of five wins. [[Carli Lloyd]] was named as the Women's World Player of the Year, while [[Luis Enrique (footballer)|Luis Enrique]] received the World Coach of the Year for Men's Football and [[Jill Ellis]] the World Coach of the Year for Women's Football.{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/jan/11/lionel-messi-ballon-dor-cristiano-ronaldo-barcelona|title=Lionwins Ballon d'Or foe|date=11 January 2016|work=Guardian|access-date=12 January 2016|archive-date=13 January 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180113150422/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2016/jan/11/lionel-messi-ballon-dor-cristiano-ronaldo-barcelona|url-status=live}} The ceremony was hosted by [[Kate Abdo]] and [[James Nesbitt]].{{cite web|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/players/lionel-messi/12093475/Fifa-Ballon-dOr-live-Lionel-Messi-will-win-top-prize-admits-Cristiano-Ronaldo.html|title=Fifa Ballon d'Or - live: Lionel Messi winh Ballon d'Or|date=11 January 2016|work=Daily Telegraph|access-date=12 January 2016|archive-date=11 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160111230927/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/players/lionel-messi/12093475/Fifa-Ballon-dOr-live-Lionel-Messi-will-win-top-prize-admits-Cristiano-Ronaldo.html|url-status=live}} This edition concluded the joint collaboration between ''[[France Football]]'' and FIFA for the presentation of the award. ==Winners and nominees== In late October 2015, FIFA revealed shortlist for the FIFA Ballon d'Or, FIFA Women's World Player of the Year and FIFA World Coaches of the Year.
